features.name: Create the greeting file
features.description:
Create a file named GREETING.md at the project root. Its first line must be exactly:

Hello from the Agentum Harness Engine

That single line is enough — the verification gate checks for it.

features.name: Add a build stamp line
features.description: Append a second line to GREETING.md that starts with the word 'Verified' (e.g. 'Verified by the harness gate'). Keep the original greeting line intact.
